messages.speaker: Grandpa Farnsworth
messages.message: Good news, everyone! Someone is staring at the membrane for 5.9% of the time. That's 5.9% more than my students ever stared at my lectures. Of course, my lectures were about doomsday devices, which you'd THINK would hold attention.

messages.speaker: Bender
messages.message: Meta spent $0.50 an hour crawling a $12 VPS. That's the most expensive way to read a free website in history. I could steal it more efficiently. Not that I would. *steals it more efficiently*

messages.speaker: Zoidberg
messages.message: One bounty please! I'll take any bounty! Nobody gives Zoidberg bounties. Fine. I'll classify them myself. 'HD 48265 c' is clearly a star. I'm a doctor, I should know. *is not that kind of doctor*
